lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as multiple vertical columns of circular high-luminance spots posterior to the gills, forming a semi-regular grid with approximately 4-5 spots per column on the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of higher pixel intensity are present, with the circular blobs positioned at the intersections of these vertical bands and horizontal axes, forming a rectilinear grid pattern.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: A prominent horizontal feature is visible along the upper flank, showing a clear linear highlight on its superior edge and a corresponding shadow on its inferior edge, extending from the gills towards the tail.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: The first dorsal fin exhibits a sparse distribution of approximately 6-8 high-luminance spots, primarily clustered within the anterior and lower portions of the fin's silhouette.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin displays a high density of small, high-luminance spots that are significantly smaller and more closely spaced than the spot pattern observed on the lateral flank.
